Name: Set Reminders Mod
Author: AelaanBluewood
Description:
This mod lets you set up ingame reminders in form of notifications that pop up on the bottom left of the screen. You can set them for a specific day and time and you can also set them to be repeatable daily, weekly, monthly (seasons) or yearly.


[b]How to access the reminders menu?
[/b]
By default the button to open the menu is set to R but that can be changed in the menu. You can also access the menu by looking for it in the generic mod menu. Use the save buttons to apply all the changes like setting a reminder or deleting them.

Downloads.Description:
This version works with Stardew Valley 1.6 so far
I also fixed the bug where events would mess up the reminders and fixed the problem where the hotkey would open the window even when the player would write something in an input field.
